title: Nourishing Malaysian Fried Rice
description: A simple, comforting dish packed with protein and fiber. This recipe is inspired by Southeast Asian flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked tofu back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well coated with the flavors.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped scallions if desired.
